# Typed ODS independent qualification

`typed.ods` was generated by `node test/ods-typed-independent-produce.cjs`
on 2026-10-23. Authored ExcelJS input is independently converted by LibreOfficeDev
26.8.0.0.alpha0 (2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5).
The fixture has numeric/boolean-looking text, true numeric percentage/currency/date
cells, styles, repeated literal rows and formulas on two sheets. The test derives
a compact three-row repetition using namespace-aware XML and labels that mutation
explicitly. It verifies actual LibreOffice reopen/recalculation and typed XLSX
readback; the application reader is not its value/type oracle.

This qualifies LibreOffice-produced ODS, not Excel-produced ODS. ZIP container
metadata is not compared after edits; unchanged file payloads are compared exactly.
